description:
Sacrifice Myr Moonvessel to Ashnod's Altar, Adding {C}{C} to your mana pool.
Stack the Myr Moonvessel trigger above the Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Allow the Myr Moonvessel trigger to resolve, adding {C} to your mana pool.
Teysa Karlov makes Myr Moonvessel's death trigger to occur twice adding an additional {C} to your mana pool.
Let the Blood Artist triggers resolve.
Pay for the Nim Deathmantle trigger with {4}, returning Myr Moonvessel to the battlefield equipped with Nim Deathmantle.
Repeat.
